zh.title: 第一次使用：从哪里开始
zh.summary: 跟着真实平台操作：从首页进入项目，填写并保存一条实验记录，再认识文档、协议创建和表格导入入口。
requirements: 已有账号；被邀请的成员先接受邀请。
视频使用本地虚构数据。画面同时展示 AI 入口；手工填写与保存不依赖 AI。
steps: 从首页“我的项目”打开工作项目，进入“协议”，选择已有协议并核对版本。
点击“新增记录”，填写虚构样本 DEMO-START、观察数量 12 和演示备注。
点击提交，核对项目、协议及版本；确认后打开已保存记录，刷新验证结果。
回到项目的“文档”页，预览会议记录模板和保存范围；本段仅展示入口，不创建文档。
已有表格时，打开匹配协议的记录列表，点击“批量上传”并下载模板；本段不执行导入，完整流程见 CSV 演示。
准备新实验时，项目“新建协议”提供 Aira 创建和模板入口；AI 关闭时使用模板。完整生成、修改、预览和保存见 Aira 创建协议演示。
返回首页，通过“我的项目”继续上次工作。项目内容按权限共享，保存前核对位置。
zh.success: 已通过真实表单保存一条虚构实验记录，并能在平台里找到文档、协议创建和 CSV 导入入口。

en.title: First visit: choose where to start
en.summary: Follow a real Platform walkthrough: open a project, fill and save a Record, then find documents, Protocol creation and CSV import.
requirements: An account; invited members must accept their invitation.
The local recording uses synthetic data and also shows AI entry points. Manual filling and saving do not require AI.
steps: Open a workspace from My projects on Home, choose Protocols, then open an existing Protocol and check its version.
Choose Add Record and enter synthetic sample DEMO-START, count 12 and a demo note.
Submit after checking the project, Protocol and version. Open the saved Record and reload to verify persistence.
Return to the project’s Documents and preview Meeting notes and its destination. This introduction shows the entry without creating a document.
For spreadsheets, open the matching Protocol’s Records, choose Bulk upload and download its template. No data is imported here; follow the CSV demo for the full workflow.
New protocol offers Aira and templates; use templates when AI is disabled. Follow the Aira Protocol demo for the full generation, refinement, preview and save workflow.
Return to Home and resume through My projects. Project content follows permissions; check the destination before saving.
en.success: One synthetic Record is saved through the real form, and you can locate document, Protocol creation and CSV import entry points.

zh.title: 填写并找回第一条 Record
zh.summary: 从已有 Protocol 开始，填写、提交，并通过修订保留更正历史。
requirements: 已加入项目，并有填写 Record 的权限。
项目已有“我的第一条 Record”示例协议，或下载下方包由有权限的成员导入。
steps: 进入项目 → 协议，打开示例协议，阅读说明和版本。
点击“新增记录”，填写样本标识 DEMO-001、观察数量 12 和“虚构演示数据”备注。
提交前核对必填项；草稿只保存在当前设备，不等于提交。
点击提交，核对项目、协议版本，再确认提交 Record。
点击“查看已保存记录”，刷新后仍能看到刚才的值。
如需更正，点击“修订”，将数量改为 13，填写更正原因并提交。原修订仍可查看。
zh.success: Record 已保存到指定项目和协议；刷新可读，修订保留原值。

en.title: Submit and find your first Record
en.summary: Use an existing Protocol, submit observations and preserve corrections as revisions.
requirements: Project membership with permission to create Records.
The project contains the First Record example, or an authorized member imports the package below.
steps: Open the project’s Protocols and read the example’s instructions and version.
Start a Record. Enter DEMO-001, observation count 12 and a note saying synthetic demonstration data.
Check required fields. A draft is stored on this device and is not a submitted Record.
Submit, verify the project and Protocol version, then confirm.
Open View saved Record and reload to check persistence.
To correct it, choose Revise, change the count to 13 and provide a correction reason. The original revision remains available.
en.success: The Record persists in the selected project and Protocol, with the original values retained in revision history.

zh.title: 写下第一份研究文档
zh.summary: 无需先准备 Protocol，选择模板写下想法、观察或会议内容。
requirements: 已有账号；个人文档可直接创建。
项目或实验室文档需要相应范围的写入权限。
steps: 从主导航进入“文档”，确认页面标题为“我的文档”。
点击“新建文档”，选择“会议记录”模板并预览结构。
填写标题“演示：样品观察讨论”，确认保存位置为个人空间，再创建。
在可视化编辑器写下观察、决定和下一步；等待“已保存”。
打开保存位置与权限说明，确认个人文档仅自己可见。
返回列表，按日期或搜索找回文档，再打开核对正文。需要团队共享时，从对应项目或实验室入口新建。
zh.success: 不用先创建 Protocol，也能保存并找回一份有明确归属的研究文档。

en.title: Write your first research document
en.summary: Use a template for an idea, observation or meeting without preparing a Protocol first.
requirements: An account; personal documents can be created directly.
Project or Lab documents require write access to that scope.
steps: Open Documents in navigation and check that you are in My documents.
Choose New document, select Meeting notes and preview the template.
Enter Demo: sample observation discussion, confirm the personal destination, then create.
Write observations, decisions and next steps in the visual editor; wait for Saved.
Check the destination and visibility: a personal document is visible only to you.
Return to the list, search or filter by date, and reopen the content. Start from a project or Lab when creating shared work.
en.success: A research document is saved and discoverable without requiring a Protocol, with clear ownership and visibility.

zh.title: 从模板建立第一个 Protocol
zh.summary: 修改说明与字段，检查可填写效果，再保存到选定项目。
requirements: 有在目标项目创建 Protocol 的权限。
本示例为虚构入门练习；用于真实实验前需调整约束并审核。
steps: 进入项目 → 协议 → 新建协议，选择“从模板开始”。
选择第一条 Record 模板，填写新协议名称。
在可视化编辑器修改说明，保留稳定字段 ID；调整字段时核对类型、必填和范围。
等待语法检查通过；有错误时先修正，校验通过只说明结构有效。
切到预览，用示例数据测试表单；预览值不会保存为 Record。
保存时核对实验室、项目、名称及版本；保存完成后打开 Protocol。
zh.success: 项目中出现可填写的新 Protocol；正式记录从该协议的记录入口创建。

en.title: Create your first Protocol from a template
en.summary: Edit instructions and fields, preview the form, then save it to a project.
requirements: Permission to create a Protocol in the target project.
This is a synthetic introduction. Adapt constraints and review them before real experiments.
steps: Open Project → Protocols → New protocol and choose Start from a template.
Select the First Record template and name the new Protocol.
Edit instructions visually. Keep field IDs stable and check types, required fields and limits when changing fields.
Wait for syntax validation. Resolve errors before saving; validation establishes structural validity only.
Switch to Preview and test example data. Preview values do not create Records.
Check the Lab, project, name and version when saving, then open the saved Protocol.
en.success: The project contains a fillable Protocol, ready for Records through its record entry.

zh.title: 导入第一份 CSV 表格
zh.summary: 使用协议生成的模板，先排除错误，再预检并确认导入。
requirements: 目标项目已有示例 Protocol，且你有创建 Record 的权限。
示例 CSV 只适用于下方示例协议；其他协议应下载各自模板。
steps: 打开示例 Protocol 的 Records，点击“批量上传”。
下载 CSV 模板，保留 var.sample_label、var.observation_count、var.notes 标准表头。
用文本或表格工具按模板整理：DEMO-101 数量为 0，DEMO-102 数量为 12。保存 UTF-8 CSV；0 是有效值。
选择故意错误的示例文件并预检，查看字段和行号；校验失败不会创建 Record。
点击“更换文件”，选择修正后的示例，再次预检。通过后核对条数、目标 Protocol 和版本。
勾选确认，点击“确认导入”；返回列表并刷新，核对两条数据。成功导入后勿重复上传同一文件。
zh.success: 错误文件未写入数据；修正后确认导入恰好两条，刷新可见。

en.title: Import your first CSV spreadsheet
en.summary: Use the Protocol’s template, resolve errors, preview and confirm the import.
requirements: The example Protocol exists in a project where you can create Records.
These CSV files match the supplied example Protocol only. Download separate templates for other Protocols.
steps: Open the example Protocol’s Records and choose Bulk upload.
Download the CSV template and keep the standard var.sample_label, var.observation_count and var.notes headers.
Prepare DEMO-101 with count 0 and DEMO-102 with count 12 using a text or spreadsheet editor. Save UTF-8 CSV; zero is a valid observation.
Select the intentionally invalid example and validate it. Read its field and row errors; no Record is created.
Choose Replace file, select the corrected example and validate again. Check the count, destination and Protocol version.
Acknowledge and confirm the import. Reload the list and verify both rows. Do not upload the same file again after a successful import.
en.success: Invalid input writes nothing; the corrected file creates exactly two Records after confirmation.

zh.title: 用 Aira 创建并完善 Protocol
zh.summary: 描述需求，检查 AI 草稿，通过对话修改，再预览并保存。
requirements: 实例已开启 AI，账号有模型使用权限；模型调用可能产生费用。
使用专用私有教学项目，所有样本与数值均为虚构。
有相应项目的协议、记录或分析写入权限。
steps: 从项目中新建协议，选择 Aira 创建。我们使用独立的教学项目。
用自然语言说明研究目标、字段和约束。这里仅需要样本编号、观察数量和备注。
点击生成。Aira 会调用真实模型起草协议，平台随后检查语法。
继续对话，请 Aira 增加提交前核对样本编号的说明，保持字段不变。
检查修改结果并确认语法通过。语法有效不代表实验方案已经经过科学审核。
进入填写预览，用示例数据检查表单。这里的测试值不会创建正式记录。
点击保存，核对项目、协议名称和版本。确认后才会保存到项目。
打开保存后的协议，再刷新核对。现在团队可以按权限开始填写记录。
zh.success: 打开保存后的协议，再刷新核对。现在团队可以按权限开始填写记录。

en.title: Create and refine a Protocol with Aira
en.summary: Describe your needs, review an AI draft, refine it in conversation, then preview and save.
requirements: AI is enabled and your account can use a model. Model calls may incur charges.
Use a dedicated private demo project with synthetic samples and values.
Permission to create the relevant Protocol, Record or analysis in that project.
steps: Create a Protocol in a dedicated demo project and choose Aira.
Describe the goal, fields and constraints: sample label, observation count and notes.
Generate a draft with the real model. Platform then checks its syntax.
Continue the conversation: add an instruction to check sample labels, keeping fields unchanged.
Review the edit and syntax result. Valid syntax is not scientific validation.
Open the form preview and test example values. Preview data creates no Records.
Choose Save and check the project, Protocol name and version before confirming.
Open the saved Protocol and reload to verify it. Authorized members can now create Records.
en.success: Open the saved Protocol and reload to verify it. Authorized members can now create Records.

zh.title: 与 Aira 对话填写 Record
zh.summary: 先问字段，再提供数值；逐项核对、手动修改并保存。
requirements: 实例已开启 AI，账号有模型使用权限；模型调用可能产生费用。
使用专用私有教学项目，所有样本与数值均为虚构。
有相应项目的协议、记录或分析写入权限。
steps: 打开已有协议的记录表单，切换到左侧 Aira 对话。右侧仍是可编辑表单。
先询问两个字段的含义，明确只解释、不填写。
接着说，把刚才那两项填为指定值。Aira 根据同一段对话，将明确提供的值填入空字段。
再次提出修改。已有值先显示逐字段建议，不会直接被覆盖。
逐项处理：样本编号保留原值，观察数量接受替换。
也可以手动改成十四，填写备注并保存草稿。刷新后检查草稿仍然存在。
提交前检查数据和保存位置。AI 填入的内容同样需要你确认。
确认提交后打开记录并刷新。对话帮助填写，最终结果保存在正式记录里。
zh.success: 确认提交后打开记录并刷新。对话帮助填写，最终结果保存在正式记录里。

en.title: Fill a Record in conversation with Aira
en.summary: Ask about fields, provide values, review individual changes and save.
requirements: AI is enabled and your account can use a model. Model calls may incur charges.
Use a dedicated private demo project with synthetic samples and values.
Permission to create the relevant Protocol, Record or analysis in that project.
steps: Open a Record and select Aira on the left. The form on the right stays editable.
First ask what two fields mean, without filling them.
Then provide values for those two fields. Aira uses the same conversation to fill empty fields.
Ask for another change. Existing values receive individual suggestions instead of silent replacement.
Review each suggestion: keep the sample label and accept the new count.
You can also edit the count to 14, add a note and save a draft. Reload to verify it.
Check the data and destination before submitting. AI-filled values still need your review.
Confirm, open the saved Record and reload. The final values belong to the Record, not just the chat.
en.success: Confirm, open the saved Record and reload. The final values belong to the Record, not just the chat.

zh.title: 向 Aira 提问并保存分析结果
zh.summary: 从自然语言问题到真实计算、可追溯解释和可复用分析方法。
requirements: 实例已开启 AI，账号有模型使用权限；模型调用可能产生费用。
使用专用私有教学项目，所有样本与数值均为虚构。
有相应项目的协议、记录或分析写入权限。
先导入下方分析示例 Protocol，再通过批量上传导入配套 CSV；两组各 3 条。勿重复导入。
steps: 打开记录列表，分析当前筛选结果。这六条读数全部为虚构教学数据。
输入分析问题：按组比较读数。先阅读模型调用说明，再同意生成分析建议。
Aira 根据字段和问题生成分析草稿，此时尚未执行计算。
检查并采用建议，再预览数据范围和分析设置。
确认执行。平台根据实际记录计算，两组平均值分别是十二和十八。
让 Aira 解释计算结果。说明中的指标带有来源，虚构数据不能用于科研结论。
将分析配置保存为方法，以后可以对新记录再次运行。
刷新页面，检查报告、图表和解释仍可查看。成果保存在项目中。
zh.success: 刷新页面，检查报告、图表和解释仍可查看。成果保存在项目中。

en.title: Ask Aira and save a reproducible analysis
en.summary: Go from a question to computation, traceable interpretation and a reusable method.
requirements: AI is enabled and your account can use a model. Model calls may incur charges.
Use a dedicated private demo project with synthetic samples and values.
Permission to create the relevant Protocol, Record or analysis in that project.
Import the supplied Protocol, then bulk-import its CSV once: three Records per group. Avoid duplicate imports.
steps: Open the Records list and analyze the filtered results. All six readings are synthetic.
Ask to compare readings by group. Read the disclosure before consenting to model use.
Aira proposes an analysis from the question and fields. No computation has run yet.
Review and adopt the proposal, then preview the data scope and settings.
Confirm execution. Platform computes from the Records: the group means are 12 and 18.
Ask Aira to explain the computed results. Metrics have sources; synthetic data cannot establish research findings.
Save the analysis configuration as a reusable method for future Records.
Reload and verify that the report, charts and explanation persist in the project.
en.success: Reload and verify that the report, charts and explanation persist in the project.
